messages:
Ana: Thanks for the all-hands — quick follow-ups on the reliability incident we covered. Can folks help clarifying owners/timelines so we can close action items:
- RCA link?
- Who owns the routing change rollback and guarded rollout?
- Any roadmap items we should defer?
- Who will own customer comms?
I'll collect answers here, thanks! :heart:

incident-bot: RCA posted: https://redwood.infra/rcas/INC-2026-4321 — exec summary: transient router overload due to autoscale race + slow KV cache warm path. Full timeline + logs in doc.

Cory: Short answers — we rolled back the routing optimizer at ~03:12 UTC during the incident. Owner for the guarded rollout: eng-runtime (Cory). Plan: canary rollout with traffic caps + automatic fallback by Fri EOD. I'll open the PR and tag eng-runtime, will add notes in the PR.

Marta: Monitoring/runbook notes:
- Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abc123/incident-routers
- Alert updated: data_plane_router_95th_latency > 300ms for 5m
- Quick check command: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=router --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp`
I added a runbook entry for KV warm-start behavior and short-term mitigation steps.

Devon: I'll own customer comms — will draft status for Support + CSMs and post here by EOD. @Priya can you review for any roadmap/cx implications?

Priya: Thanks @Devon. For roadmap impacts: recommend freezing the adaptive-routing-v2 rollout and moving it to next quarter unless canary shows clear perf gains. Please create a ticket in product tracker (REL-789) and tag me for prioritization.

Ana: Please add all action items to this shared tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abcdExampleTracker and set owners/ETAs. I'll follow up on Monday in the sync. :eyes:

incident-bot: Action checklist created: https://redwood.infra/actions/INC-2026-4321 — items: triage, rollback validation, canary plan, customer comms, postmortem writeup.

Marta: I updated the runbook and pinged @eng-oncall. Short-term mitigation applied: lowered router max-inflight to 80% GPU capacity to avoid overload while we test canary.

Cory: Note for leadership — boundary-condition fix (race in autoscaler) is scoped for next sprint. Owner: eng-runtime; priority P1. I'll include impact analysis in the PR.

Ana: Great progress, thanks. Final ask: everyone put ETA on their ticket in the tracker so we can mark action items done. :thumbsup:
